sky.qualification: Asteroid-2002-tx300's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: JPL Horizons fixed 2026-09-03 epoch. Illustrative ICRF pole (RA 0°, Dec +90°), arbitrary prime meridian and rotational phase. A projected limb position angle is not an inertial pole measurement.
provenance.qualification: Computed 2002 TX300 Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
